- Home or End: Go to the first or last tab.
- Read as tabs, with how many there are and which is chosen.

### Tag

A label the user added or can take away, such as an active filter or a topic. For a status like Paid or Late, use a badge.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tag

```ts
import { TagComponent } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';
```

When to use something else:

- A status the user cannot remove: [Badge](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/badge)
- Let the user type new labels: [Chip input](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/chip-input)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `removable` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the × button. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | `'Remove' from labels` | The button's first word; the tag's text follows it. Translate it. |
| `(remove)` | `void` |  | The × was pressed. Remove the tag and move focus on. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space: On the remove button, take the tag away.
- The remove button is named after the tag, such as Remove Angular.

### Text field

Label, input, hint and error as one control. The label, hint and error are tied to the input, so screen readers read all three.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field

```ts
import { TextFieldComponent } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';
// Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

When to use something else:

- Several lines of text: [Textarea](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/textarea)
- A unit or currency beside the value: [Input group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/input-group)
- A number with − and + buttons: [Number field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/number-field)
- Search with a clear button: [Search field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/search-field)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label, tied to the input. |
| `type` | `'text' \| 'email' \| 'password' \| 'search' \| 'tel' \| 'url'` | `'text'` | The input type. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under the input, read with it. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the input invalid and announces the message. |
| `autocomplete` | `string` |  | The browser autofill hint, such as email or name. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input, for tests. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The label, hint and error are tied to the input, so all three are read.
- An error is announced when it appears.

### Textarea

The multi-line twin of the text field: the same label, hint and error, with room for a few lines. The reader can make it taller.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/textarea

```ts
import { TextareaComponent } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';
// Works with formControlName, [formControl] and ngModel.
```

When to use something else:

- One line of text: [Text field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label, tied to the textarea. |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Height in lines. The reader can still make it taller. |
| `maxlength` | `number` |  | The most characters it accepts. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text under the textarea, read with it. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the textarea invalid and announces the message. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the textarea, for tests. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The same label, hint and error as the text field, all read with it.

### Timeline

A chronological record of decisions and updates. Each event can show who acted, when it happened, and the outcome, so a case's approval history is easy to scan.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/timeline

```ts
import { TimelineComponent } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';
```

When to use something else:

- Steps still to do: [Stepper](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stepper)
- Many records to sort and filter: [Data table](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/data-table)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the ordered history list. |
| `items` | `TimelineItem[]` |  | Required. Events in chronological order. |
| `TimelineItem` | `{ title, date, dateTime?, actor?, description?, status?, statusLabel? }` |  | Event details. dateTime is a machine-readable value for the semantic time element. |
| `status` | `'approved' \| 'pending' \| 'rejected'` |  | Adds a status icon and tone label to the event. |
| `statusLabel` | `string` |  | Overrides the default status text, including for translation. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- An ordered list, so screen readers say how many events there are; each date is a time element.

### Toast

A short note after an action, such as Saved, at the bottom end of the screen. Screen readers hear it as it comes. It closes by itself after 6 seconds, but never while the pointer or focus is on it, and never when it holds an action, so nobody loses the Undo to a timer.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toast

```ts
import { UiToast } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';

const toast = inject(UiToast);
// The region and close buttons take their words from provideUiLabels.
```

When to use something else:

- A message that must stay until it is fixed: [Alert](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert)
- A decision the reader must make now: [Alert dialog](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert-dialog)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show(message, options?)` | `number` |  | Shows a toast and returns its id. |
| `options.tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'info'` | Icon and colour. Danger is announced at once. |
| `options.title` | `string` |  | A few words in bold before the message. |
| `options.duration` | `number` | `6000` | Milliseconds; 0 keeps it. With an action it defaults to 0. |
| `options.action` | `{ label, run }` |  | One button; pressing it closes the toast. |
| `dismiss(id)` | `void` |  | Closes a toast. |
| `labels` | `signal` | `from provideUiLabels` | The region name and close button name. Set only to differ from provideUiLabels. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Reach the action or the close button inside a toast.
- Toasts sit in a named live region, so each one is read as it comes.
- The timer waits while the pointer or focus is on a toast, and never runs on one with an action.

### Toggle

A button that stays pressed until it is pressed again. The label stays the same; screen readers hear 'pressed' or 'not pressed', and the look changes in fill and border, not colour alone.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toggle

```ts
import { ToggleComponent } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';
```

When to use something else:

- A setting that takes effect at once, such as notifications: [Switch](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/switch)
- One of several views, such as grid or list: [Segmented control](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/segmented-control)
- An action that happens once, such as Save: [Button](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/button)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[(pressed)]` | `boolean` | `false` | Pressed or not, two-way. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Height and text size, as on Button. |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Square, for an icon alone. Give it an aria-label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Cannot be pressed. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space: Press it, or let it go.
- Read as a toggle button, pressed or not pressed; the label never changes.

### Toolbar

A row of controls that counts as one stop for the Tab key. Inside it the arrow keys move from control to control, flipped in Arabic; Home and End jump to the ends. Tab again leaves it.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toolbar

```ts
import { ToolbarComponent, ToolbarSeparatorComponent } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';
```

When to use something else:

- Two or three buttons that sit together: [Button group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/button-group)
- Links to other pages: [Navigation](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/nav)
- Actions that do not fit, behind one button: [Menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. What the controls act on, for screen readers. |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Which arrow keys move: left and right, or up and down. |
| `<ui-toolbar-separator>` | `component` |  | A line between groups of controls. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Enter the toolbar, and Tab again leaves it.
- Left or Right: Move to the previous or next control, wrapping round. Flipped in Arabic.
- Up or Down: The same, in a vertical toolbar.
- Home or End: Go to the first or last control.
- Read as a toolbar with its name and orientation.

### Tooltip

A short label for a control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus and read by screen readers as its description. The pointer can move onto it and Escape hides it. Touch screens never show tooltips, so never put anything needed in one.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tooltip

```ts
import { TooltipDirective } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';
// On the Angular CDK overlay. Add @angular/cdk/overlay-prebuilt.css.
```

When to use something else:

- Content with links or buttons: [Popover](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/popover)
- Help the reader needs to fill a field: [The field’s hint](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field)
- Show a keyboard shortcut: [Keyboard key inside the tooltip](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/kbd)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uiTooltip` | `string` |  | Required. The short label, on any focusable element. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Focus the control, and its tooltip shows.
- Escape: Hide the tooltip.
- Read as the control’s description; the pointer can move onto it.
- Touch screens never show tooltips, so nothing needed may live only in one.

### Tree

Nested items that open and close, such as folders or menu categories. One Tab stop: the arrow keys move, Right opens a branch and Left closes it, typing a name jumps to it, and Enter or Space selects. For a site's page links, use navigation instead.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tree

```ts
import { TreeComponent, type TreeNode } from '@ghazal-ui/angular';
// On the Angular CDK tree.
```

When to use something else:

- A flat list with columns: [Data table](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/data-table)
- Sections that open and close: [Accordion](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/accordion)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the tree: "Menu", "Files". |
| `nodes` | `TreeNode[]` |  | Required. { id, label, children? }, nested as deep as needed. |
| `expanded` | `string[]` | `[]` | Ids of the branches open at the start. |
| `[(selected)]` | `string \| null` | `null` | Id of the selected item. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Reach the tree; it is one Tab stop.
- Up or Down: Move to the previous or next item.
- Right: Open a branch, or move into it.
- Left: Close a branch, or move to its parent.
- Letters: Jump to the item that starts with them.
- Enter or Space: Select the item.
- Read as a tree: each item says its level, whether it is open, and whether it is selected.


# React

## Setup (React)

```sh
pnpm add @ghazal-ui/react @ghazal-ui/css
pnpm add -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
```

Needs Node 22, React 19, Tailwind 4.1.

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()] });
```

```css
/* src/index.css, imported once in main.tsx, above every other CSS import */
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@ghazal-ui/css/tailwind.css';
```

Wrap the app in `ToastProvider` if you use toasts (`useToast()` throws without it). For Arabic also wrap it in React Aria's `I18nProvider locale="ar"`.

## Components (React)

### Accordion

A stack of sections that open and close, such as questions and answers. Built on the native details element, so it opens with Enter and Space, works without script, and the browser's find-in-page opens the section that holds the match. Sections grow and shrink smoothly both ways, Up and Down move between the headings, and the chevron mirrors in Arabic.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/accordion

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Switch between views of the same thing, one at a time: [Tabs](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tabs)
- Hide one optional detail behind a button: [Popover](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/popover)
- Show steps the reader must go through in order: [Stepper](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stepper)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `single` | `boolean` | `false` | On Accordion: one section open at a time. |
| `icon` | `'end' \| 'start' \| 'none'` | `'end'` | On Accordion, or one AccordionItem: where the chevron sits. |
| `heading` | `ReactNode` |  | Required, on AccordionItem: what opens it. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | On AccordionItem: a quieter line under the heading. |
| `open, defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  | On AccordionItem: controlled, or open at first. Closing runs its motion. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | On AccordionItem: focusable and announced, but it does not open. |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | `false` | On AccordionItem: mounts the children when it opens. |
| `keep` | `boolean` | `false` | On AccordionItem: keeps lazy children once mounted. Off, they unmount once closed. |
| `...props` | `details props` |  | On AccordionItem: onToggle and the rest. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space: Open or close the section.
- Up or Down: Move to the previous or next heading, wrapping round.
- Home or End: Go to the first or last heading.
- Native details elements: they open without script, and find in page opens the section that holds the match.
- In plain HTML only the Up, Down, Home and End keys need script.

### Alert dialog

A short message that needs an answer before the reader goes on: confirm a delete, keep or discard changes. Only its buttons answer: Escape and a click outside do nothing, because the reader has to choose. Focus starts on the safest button.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert-dialog

```tsx
import { useAlertDialog } from '@ghazal-ui/react';

const { alert, confirm, dialog } = useAlertDialog();
// render {dialog} once in the component, then await alert() or confirm()
```

When to use something else:

- Ask for more than a yes or no, such as a form: [Dialog](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/dialog)
- Confirm something that can be undone: [Toast with an Undo action](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toast)
- Warn about something on the page without stopping the reader: [Alert](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `useAlertDialog()` | `{ alert, confirm, dialog }` |  | Render dialog once; alert() and confirm() return promises. |
| `alert(options)` | `Promise<R \| undefined>` |  | The value of the pressed action. |
| `confirm(options)` | `Promise<boolean>` |  | true only when the confirm button is pressed. |
| `options` | `as in Angular` |  | title, message, tone and actions; confirmLabel, cancelLabel and danger for confirm. |
| `<AlertDialog>` | `component` |  | The same dialog, controlled: open, the options, and onAction(value). |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab or Shift + Tab: Move between its buttons; focus stays inside.
- Escape and a click outside do nothing: only its buttons answer.
- Focus starts on the safest button, and the title and message are read when it opens.

### Alert

A message in the page, such as a problem with the whole form or a notice about the account. The title says what it is in words; the icon's shape and the colour repeat it. For a note after an action, use a toast; for a question that needs an answer, an alert dialog.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert

```tsx
import { Alert } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Confirm an action that just finished: [Toast](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toast)
- Stop the reader until they decide: [Alert dialog](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert-dialog)
- Show a status in a row or a card: [Badge](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/badge)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'info'` | Icon and colour. The title must say it too. |
| `title` | `string` |  | A few words in bold that say what it is. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Buttons under the message. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  | Shows a close button that calls it. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Dismiss' from labels` | Its accessible name, translated. |
| `...props` | `div props` |  | Every native div prop, such as role. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The title says what it is in words; the icon and the colour only repeat it.

### App shell

The frame every screen of an app sits in: a header across the top, the main links in a side bar, the page beside them. When the shell is narrower than 64rem the side bar folds behind a menu button and opens over the page. Escape, the shade, or following a link closes it again.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/app-shell

```tsx
import { AppShell, Nav } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Links in a side bar only, inside your own layout: [Navigation](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/nav)
- Show where the page sits in the site: [Breadcrumbs](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/breadcrumbs)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `menuLabel` | `string` | `Menu from labels` | Names the menu button. Translate it. |
| `mainId` | `string` | `main` | The id of the page area, for a "Skip to content" link. |
| `landmarks` | `boolean` | `true` | The header is the banner and the page the main landmark. Off inside a page that has them. |
| `brand \| actions \| sidebar` | `ReactNode` |  | Brand, header actions, and the links. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space: On the menu button, open the side bar on a narrow screen.
- Escape: Close the side bar.
- The header, the side bar and the page are landmarks, so screen readers can jump between them.

### Avatar group

Several people in a small space: the first few avatars overlap and a '+3' stands for the rest. The group has a name, every avatar is still named, and '+3' is read as '3 more'.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/avatar-group

```tsx
import { AvatarGroup } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- One person: [Avatar](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/avatar)
- Every name visible, such as a list of attendees: [A list or Data table](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/data-table)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Who the group is, for screen readers. |
| `people` | `AvatarPerson[]` |  | Required. { name, src? } for each person, in order. |
| `max` | `number` | `4` | How many avatars to show before "+n". |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Size of every avatar. |
| `moreLabel` | `(count: number) => string` | `(n) => `${n} more` from labels` | The spoken name of "+n". Translate it. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The group has a name, every avatar is still named, and +3 is read as 3 more.

### Avatar

A person's photo, or their initials when there is no photo or it fails to load. Screen readers hear the person's name, never the file name.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/avatar

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Show several people in a small space: [Avatar group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/avatar-group)
- Show a status next to a person, such as online: [Status dot](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/status-dot)
- A logo or a product picture: A plain img with alt text

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  | Required. Read by screen readers and turned into the initials. |
| `src` | `string` |  | The photo. Initials show while it is missing or broken. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 32, 40 or 56 pixels. |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides it from screen readers, for when the name is on screen next to it. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Screen readers hear the person’s name, never the file name.

### Badge

A short status label, such as the state of an order. The words carry the meaning and the colour only repeats it, so every status reads the same without colour.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/badge

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A label the user added or can remove, such as a filter: [Tag](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tag)
- A live state such as online or offline: [Status dot](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/status-dot)
- A message the reader must read: [Alert](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'neutral'` | The colour. The text must say the status too. |
| `...props` | `span props` |  | Every native span prop: id, title, ref. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The words carry the status; the colour only repeats them.

### Bottom sheet

A panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen, for a short choice or the details of an item, mostly on phones. It is a dialog docked to the bottom: focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, and Escape, the close button or a click above it closes it.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/bottom-sheet

```tsx
import { Dialog } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A task on a wide screen: [Dialog](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/dialog)
- Navigation or filters that slide in from the side: [Drawer](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/drawer)
- A short list of actions: [Menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'alert' \| 'drawer' \| 'sheet'` | `'default'` | 'sheet': docked to the bottom. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Its width on a wide screen: 24, 32 or 48rem. The full width on a phone. |
| `everything else` | `Dialog API` |  | title, description, open, onOpenChange, actions, dismissable and closeLabel work as in the dialog. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab or Shift + Tab: Move between the controls inside; focus stays inside.
- Escape: Close, and put focus back on the button that opened it.
- A dialog docked to the bottom, named by its title; the page behind stops scrolling.

### Breadcrumbs

Where the page sits, as a trail of links back up. A named navigation landmark around an ordered list; the last item is the page itself, marked as current and not a link. The slashes are drawn, not read out.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/breadcrumbs

```tsx
import { Breadcrumbs } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- The main links of the app: [Navigation](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/nav)
- Steps of a task in order: [Stepper](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stepper)
- Pages of a long list: [Pagination](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/pagination)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `'Breadcrumb' from labels` | Names the landmark, translated. |
| `children` | `<li> elements` |  | One per step; the last holds aria-current="page". |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- A named navigation landmark around an ordered list; the last item is marked as the current page.
- The slashes are drawn, not read out.

### Button group

Buttons that belong together, joined into one bar. The group has a name, so a screen reader says what the buttons are for before it reads them.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/button-group

```tsx
import { Button, ButtonGroup } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- One choice that changes the view: [Segmented control](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/segmented-control)
- Many controls with arrow-key movement, as in an editor: [Toolbar](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toolbar)
- More actions than fit on a phone: [Menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. What the buttons do together, for screen readers. |
| `...props` | `div props` |  | Every native div prop. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Move from button to button.
- A named group, read before its buttons.

### Button

Styles the native button, so it keeps everything the browser gives a button: focus, Enter and Space, form submit. Nine variants, three sizes, icons, and hover, press and focus feedback.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/button

```tsx
import { Button } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Go to another page: A link (a href)
- A state that stays on or off, such as bold: [Toggle](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toggle)
- Several actions that belong together: [Button group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/button-group)
- More actions than fit, behind one button: [Menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger' \| 'outline' \| 'soft' \| 'link' \| 'success' \| 'warning'` | `'primary'` | How much the button stands out. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Padding and text size. Height never drops under 44 pixels. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button, sets aria-busy and shows a spinner. |
| `startIcon / endIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon before or after the label. The spinner replaces startIcon while loading. |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Square button for a lone icon. Add an aria-label. |
| `...props` | `button props` |  | Every native button prop: type, onClick, disabled, form, ref. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space: Press the button.
- A native button, so its role, focus and form submit come from the browser.
- A button with only an icon needs a label in words for screen readers.

### Calendar

A month grid to pick a day or a range, such as a delivery day or a stay. One Tab stop: arrow keys move by day and week, Home and End go to the ends of the week, Page Up and Page Down change the month, with Shift the year. Each day is read in full, Thursday, 19 November 2026. Today is underlined and picked days are filled, so neither depends on colour. Use it when seeing the month helps: open and closed days, a range, or the weekday. For a date people already know, such as a birthday, use the date field.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/calendar

```tsx
import { Calendar, RangeCalendar, type DateRange } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
// Dates are ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD). Language follows the nearest I18nProvider from react-aria-components.
```

When to use something else:

- A date the reader already knows, such as a birthday: [Date picker](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/date-picker)
- A time or a date and time: [Text field with type time](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the calendar for screen readers. Required. |
| `min \| max` | `string` |  | Earliest and latest days that can be picked, as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `isDisabled` | `(date: string) => boolean` |  | Other days that can not be picked, such as closed days. |
| `value \| defaultValue` | `string \| null` |  | Calendar: controlled or starting day. |
| `onChange` | `(date: string) => void` |  | Calendar: called with the picked day. |
| `RangeCalendar value \| onChange` | `DateRange` |  | { start, end }, reported once both ends are picked. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Reach the grid, on the chosen or focused day.
- Left or Right: Move by a day. Flipped in Arabic.
- Up or Down: Move by a week.
- Home or End: Go to the start or end of the week.
- Page Up or Page Down: Go to the previous or next month.
- Shift + Page Up or Shift + Page Down: Go to the previous or next year.
- Enter or Space: Pick the day.
- Each day is read in full, such as Thursday, 19 November 2026.
- Today is underlined and picked days are filled, so neither depends on colour.

### Card

A surface that groups related content: a summary, a list, a form. Cards are flat, with a thin border; shadows are kept for things that float, like menus and dialogs.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/card

```tsx
import { Card } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Separate two groups with a line only: [Divider](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/divider)
- Label and value pairs, such as order details: [Property list](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/property-list)
- One number and how it changed: [Stat](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stat)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Optional heading at the top of the card. |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | The heading level of the title. |
| `padding` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 1.5rem or 2rem inside the border. |
| `...props` | `div props` |  | Every native div prop: id, aria-label, ref. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- A card with a heading reads as its own part of the page; give it one when it stands alone.

### Checkbox

A yes or no that is saved with the form, such as accepting the terms. The native checkbox in the primary colour; the whole label is the hit area, at least 44px tall.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/checkbox

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
// Every other prop goes to the input: checked, onChange, name, ref.
```

When to use something else:

- One choice from a few options: [Radio group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/radio-group)
- A setting that takes effect at once: [Switch](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/switch)
- Several choices from a long list: [Combobox or Chip input](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/chip-input)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help text, read with the checkbox. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks it invalid and announces the message. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a dash: some of the items under it are ticked. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input. |
| `...props` | `input props` |  | Every native input prop: checked, defaultChecked, onChange, name, ref. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Space: Tick or untick it.
- The native checkbox, named by its label; the whole label is the hit area.

### Chip input

A text field that collects several short values, such as toppings, email addresses or skills. Each value becomes a tag with its own named remove button. Screen readers hear each value being added and removed, and focus never falls off the field.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/chip-input

```tsx
import { ChipInput } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- One value from a known list: [Combobox](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/combobox)
- A few choices that fit on screen: [Checkbox](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/checkbox)
- Show labels the user cannot type: [Tag](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tag)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the field and the list of tags. |
| `hint \| placeholder` | `string` |  | Help under the field; text in the empty field. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | `'Remove' from labels` | First word of each × button's name. Translate it. |
| `addedLabel \| removedLabel` | `(chip: string) => string` | ``${c} added` from labels` | What screen readers hear after a change. Translate them. |
| `value \| defaultValue` | `string[]` |  | Controlled or starting tags. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string[]) => void` |  | Called after each add and remove. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | No typing, no removing. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or ,: Add what is typed as a tag.
- Backspace: In an empty field, move to the last tag’s remove button.
- Enter or Space: On a remove button, remove that tag.
- Each tag has its own remove button, named after its value.
- Adding and removing are announced, and focus moves to the next tag or back to the field.

### Combobox

A text field that filters a list as you type, for a long list such as countries. Focus stays in the field: arrow keys move through the matches, Enter picks one and Escape closes the list. The value is always one of the options.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/combobox

```tsx
import { Combobox } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- One choice from fewer than about 10 options: [Select](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/select)
- Several values: [Chip input](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/chip-input)
- Find a page or run a command from anywhere: [Command palette](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/command-palette)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the field and the list. |
| `options` | `SelectOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? }. |
| `value, defaultValue` | `T \| null` |  | The chosen value, controlled or not. |
| `onChange` | `(value: T \| null) => void` |  | Called with the picked value, or null when the field is emptied. |
| `placeholder, hint, error` | `string` |  | As for the text field. |
| `emptyText` | `string` | `'No matches' from labels` | Announced when nothing matches. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables the field. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Sends the value with a native form. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input; options get -option-<index>. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Up or Down: Open the list and move through the matches, wrapping round.
- Enter: Pick the highlighted match.
- Escape: Close the list.
- Focus stays in the field; the highlighted match is read as it moves.

### Command palette

A search over the app's actions, in a dialog. Ctrl+K or ⌘K opens it from anywhere; typing filters, the arrow keys move and Enter runs. Screen readers hear how many commands match as you type. Keep a visible button for it too: a shortcut nobody knows about is no way in.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/command-palette

```tsx
import { CommandPalette, type Command } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Pick a value inside a form: [Combobox](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/combobox)
- Search the items of one list: [Search field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/search-field)
- A few actions on one thing: [Menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commands` | `Command[]` |  | Required. { id, label, keywords?, shortcut? }. Keywords find a command by other words; shortcut is only shown. |
| `shortcut` | `string \| null` | `'k'` | The letter that opens it with Ctrl or ⌘. null turns it off. |
| `title \| placeholder` | `string` | `'Commands' from labels` | Names the dialog and the field; text in the empty field. |
| `emptyLabel \| closeLabel` | `string` |  | Shown when nothing matches; the close button. Translate them. |
| `countLabel` | `(count: number) => string` | ``${n} commands` from labels` | Announced as you type. Translate it. |
| `open \| onOpenChange` | `boolean \| (open) => void` |  | Open or closed; Ctrl+K and Escape call onOpenChange. |
| `onRun` | `(command: Command) => void` |  | The command to run, after the dialog has closed and focus is back. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Ctrl + K or ⌘ + K: Open it from anywhere.
- Up or Down: Move through the matching commands, wrapping round.
- Enter: Run the highlighted command.
- Escape: Close it.
- How many commands match is announced as you type.
- Keep a visible button for it too: a shortcut nobody knows about is no way in.

### Context menu

Actions that open where the reader right-clicks, long-presses, or presses Shift+F10 on the focused item. It is a shortcut: the same actions must also be somewhere visible, because touch and keyboard users rarely look for one.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/context-menu

```tsx
import { ContextMenu } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- The visible way to the same actions: [Menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu)
- Actions that should always be on screen: [Toolbar](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toolbar)
- Search every command in the app: [Command palette](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/command-palette)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `MenuAction[]` |  | Required. { id, label, danger?, disabled? } for each action. |
| `onAction` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called with the chosen action's id; the menu then closes. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Right-click shows the browser menu instead. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | The area that opens the menu. Make it focusable. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Shift + F10 or Menu: Open the menu on the focused item.
- Up or Down: Move through the actions.
- Enter or Space: Run the action.
- Escape: Close it.
- It is a shortcut: the same actions must also be somewhere visible.

### Data table

Rows of records the reader scans and compares: orders, users, payments. A real table, named by its caption, so screen readers announce the row and column of every cell. Sorting is announced too.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/data-table

```tsx
import { DataTable, type TableColumn, type TableSort } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A few label and value pairs: [Property list](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/property-list)
- Events in time order: [Timeline](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/timeline)
- Nested items such as folders: [Tree](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tree)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption` | `string` |  | Required. Names the table; screen readers announce it. |
| `hideCaption` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the caption for screen readers only. |
| `columns` | `TableColumn<T>[]` |  | Required. { key, header, sortable?, align?, value?, cell? } per column. |
| `rows` | `T[]` |  | Required. The rows of the current page. |
| `sort / onSortChange` | `TableSort \| null / (sort) => void` |  | The sort state, controlled. Sort the rows yourself. |
| `rowKey` | `keyof T \| (row) => Key` |  | Used as the React key of each row. |
| `loading / loadingLabel` | `boolean / string` | `false / 'Loading'` | Marks the table busy and reads the label once. |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `'No results' from labels` | Shown when there are no rows; pass the translated text. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space: On a column heading, sort by it.
- A real table named by its caption, so the row and column of every cell are read.
- The sorted column is marked, and the new order is announced.

### Date picker

A date to type or pick, or a range of dates for a stay. Type dates in the reader's own order, or open the calendar beside them or with Alt + Down. Unlike the browser's own picker, this calendar can close off days, such as a shop's day off. For ordinary dates and times, the native fields below use the browser's localized pickers. Date values stay plain ISO dates.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/date-picker

```tsx
import { DatePicker, TextField } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Pick days by looking at a month, or a range: [Calendar](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/calendar)
- A time only: [Text field with type time](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the field and the calendar. |
| `min \| max` | `string` |  | Earliest and latest dates, as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `isDisabled` | `(date: string) => boolean` |  | Days that cannot be picked, such as closed days. |
| `hint \| error` | `string` |  | Help text, and the translated error that marks it invalid. |
| `calendarLabel` | `string` | `Choose date from labels` | Names the calendar button. Translate it. |
| `selection` | `'single' \| 'range'` | `'single'` | Shows one date field, or two fields for a date range. |
| `rangeStartLabel \| rangeEndLabel` | `string` | `'Start date' \| 'End date' from labels` | Accessible names for the two fields in range mode. |
| `type (TextField)` | `'date' \| 'time' \| 'datetime-local' \| 'number'` |  | Use the browser native picker for dates and times, or a basic number input. |
| `min, max, step (TextField)` | `string \| number` |  | Pass the native range and step attributes through to the input. |
| `value \| defaultValue \| onChange` | `string \| DateRange \| null` |  | Controlled or starting value. Range mode takes two ISO dates. Language and order follow the nearest I18nProvider. |
| `disabled \| name` | `boolean \| string` |  | With name, the date is submitted with a form. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Alt + Down: Open the calendar from the field.
- Escape: Close the calendar, and put focus back on the field.
- The fields take dates typed in the reader’s own order; the calendar keys are listed on the Calendar page.

### Dialog

A modal window for a task that needs the reader's full attention: a short form, details, terms. Focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, and Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/dialog

```tsx
import { Dialog } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A yes or no question that must be answered: [Alert dialog](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert-dialog)
- Content beside the page, such as filters: [Drawer](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/drawer)
- A short note next to the button: [Popover](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/popover)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Required. The heading; it names the dialog. |
| `open / onOpenChange` | `boolean / (open) => void` |  | Required. onOpenChange(false) comes from Escape, the backdrop or the close button. |
| `description` | `string` |  | A sentence under the title, read with it. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 24, 32 or 48rem wide, never wider than the screen. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | The buttons; they line up at the end and stay in view. |
| `dismissable` | `boolean` | `true` | false: only your own buttons close it. Escape and a click outside do nothing, and the close button is hidden. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Close' from labels` | Accessible name of the close button; pass the translated text. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab or Shift + Tab: Move between the controls inside; focus stays inside.
- Escape: Close, and put focus back on the button that opened it.
- Named by its title; the page behind stops scrolling and cannot be reached.

### Divider

A thin line between groups of content. Reach for space first: a divider is for when space alone does not show where one group ends.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/divider

```tsx
import { Divider } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A frame around a group: [Card](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/card)
- Space between groups: Tailwind gap or margin classes

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Which way the line runs. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Words in the middle of the line, read as text. Horizontal only. |
| `...props` | `div props` |  | Every native div prop. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Read as a separator; a divider with words in the middle is read as those words instead.

### Drawer

A side panel that slides in from the edge, for a form or the details of a row, while the list stays in sight. It is a dialog docked to the side: focus moves into it and stays there, the page behind stops scrolling, only the body scrolls, and Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/drawer

```tsx
import { Dialog } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A focused task in the middle of the screen: [Dialog](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/dialog)
- A panel on a phone: [Bottom sheet](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/bottom-sheet)
- The main links of the app on a phone: [App shell](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/app-shell)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'alert' \| 'drawer'` | `'default'` | 'drawer': full height on the inline end. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | 24, 32 or 48rem wide; the full width on a phone. |
| `everything else` | `Dialog API` |  | title, description, open, onOpenChange, actions, dismissable and closeLabel work as in the dialog. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab or Shift + Tab: Move between the controls inside; focus stays inside.
- Escape: Close, and put focus back on the button that opened it.
- A dialog docked to the side, named by its title; the page behind stops scrolling.

### Empty state

What a list, table or page shows while it has nothing in it. It says what will appear here, why it is empty now, and offers the one action that fills it.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/empty-state

```tsx
import { EmptyState } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Content that is still loading: [Skeleton](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/skeleton)
- Something went wrong: [Alert](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/alert)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Required. What is missing, as a heading. |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | Heading level of the title, so it fits the page outline. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | The action that fills the space. One, usually. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Its title is a heading, at the level you set so it fits the page outline.

### Fieldset

A titled group of fields inside a longer form. Screen readers read the legend as they enter the group, so a field called Street is heard as part of the delivery address.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/fieldset

```tsx
import { Fieldset } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A frame around content that is not a form: [Card](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/card)
- One choice from a few, with a group label: [Radio group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/radio-group)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `legend` | `string` |  | Required. The group title. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | A line under the legend, read with the group. |
| `...props` | `fieldset props` |  | Every native fieldset prop, such as disabled. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The legend is read when focus enters the group, so each field is heard as part of it.

### File field

The browser's own file input, with a label, hint and error, in a zone that also takes files dropped on it. The native button and file names stay, so it works with the keyboard, screen readers and phone cameras as usual.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/file-field

```tsx
import { FileField } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
// onFiles gets a File[] for a pick or a drop. Every other prop goes to the input.
```

When to use something else:

- Typed text or a link to a file: [Text field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label. |
| `onFiles` | `(files: File[]) => void` |  | Called after a pick or a drop. |
| `hint, error, dropText` | `string` |  | As in Angular. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the input. |
| `...props` | `input props` |  | Every native input prop: accept, multiple, name, onChange, ref. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space: Open the file chooser.
- The browser’s own file input: the button and the chosen file names are read as usual.
- Dropping files is a shortcut; the button always works.

### Icons

A small set of sharp, adaptable marks. Find one by name or meaning, then shape it to fit.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/foundations/icons

### Input group

A text field with fixed text inside its box, before or after the value: a currency, a unit, a domain. The text is read with the field, so 'Price, EGP' is heard, but it is never part of the value.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/input-group

```tsx
import { TextField } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A number with − and + buttons: [Number field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/number-field)
- A phone number with its country code: [Phone field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/phone-field)
- A search box with a clear button: [Search field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/search-field)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prefix` | `string` |  | Text before the value, such as "EGP". Read after the label. |
| `suffix` | `string` |  | Text after the value, such as "kg" or ".com". |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Every other Text field option works too: see Text field. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The text before or after the value is read with the field, such as Price, EGP, but is never part of the value.

### Keyboard key

A key to press, on the native kbd element, so screen readers and search engines know it is a key. For a shortcut write one key per element, with the joining + as plain text.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/kbd

```tsx
import { Kbd } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Code or a value the reader types, such as a coupon: A plain code element
- A short label for a status: [Badge](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/badge)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | The key name. |
| `...props` | `kbd props` |  | Every native kbd prop. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The native kbd element, so screen readers and search engines know it is a key.

### Language switcher

Switches the interface language. Each language is named in itself, so someone who reads only that language can find it, and carries its lang, so screen readers say it in the right voice. No flags: a flag is a country, not a language. Set lang and dir on the html element when the language changes.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/language-switcher

```tsx
import { LanguageSwitcher, type Language } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Any other choice from a list: [Select](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/select)
- Switch between views of a page: [Segmented control](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/segmented-control)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `languages` | `Language[]` |  | Required. { code, name }, each name in its own language. |
| `current` | `string` |  | Required. The current language's code. |
| `onChange` | `(code: string) => void` |  | Required. Called with the chosen language's code. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Language' from labels` | Three or more: read before the current name on the button. Translate it. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | The button's size. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space or Down: Open the list of languages.
- Up or Down: Move through the languages.
- Escape: Close it, and put focus back on the button.
- Each language is named in itself and carries its lang, so it is read in the right voice.

### Menu

A short list of actions that opens from a button, such as the actions on a row. Enter, Space or the down arrow open it, the arrow keys and typing move through it, and Escape closes it and puts focus back on the button. For choosing a value, use a select.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu

```tsx
import { Menu } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- The same actions on right-click or a long press: [Context menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/context-menu)
- Pick a value that a form sends: [Select](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/select)
- Links that go to other pages: [Navigation](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/nav)
- Two or three actions that fit on screen: [Button group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/button-group)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Required. The button's content. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | The button's name, when its content is an icon. |
| `items` | `MenuAction[]` |  | Required. { id, label, danger?, disabled? }. |
| `onAction` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Required. Called with the chosen action's id. |
| `variant` | `ButtonVariant` | `'secondary'` | The button's look. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space or Down: Open the menu from its button.
- Up or Down: Move through the actions.
- Letters: Jump to the action that starts with them.
- Enter or Space: Run the action.
- Escape: Close it, and put focus back on the button.
- Read as a menu of items; the button says it opens a menu.

### Meter

A level inside a known range: storage used, a plan's limit, a score. It is not work in progress, that is Progress. The value is written next to the label, so the tone colour only repeats what the words say.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/meter

```tsx
import { Meter } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Work that is still going, such as an upload: [Progress](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/progress)
- One number and how it changed: [Stat](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stat)
- A value the reader sets: [Slider](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/slider)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. What is measured. |
| `value` | `number` |  | Required. The level now, between min and max. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` | The lowest level. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | The highest level. |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | The value in words, shown and read: "7.2 of 10 GB". Defaults to a percentage. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'neutral'` | Colour of the fill. You decide it from the value. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The native meter, named by its label, with the value in words beside it.

### Navigation

The app's main links, in a side bar. A named navigation landmark, links at least 44px tall, and the current page marked with a bar and bold text, not only a fill. On a phone, put the same links in a drawer.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/nav

```tsx
import { Nav } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A whole app layout with header and side bar: [App shell](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/app-shell)
- Views of one page: [Tabs](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tabs)
- Where the page sits in the site: [Breadcrumbs](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/breadcrumbs)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the landmark. |
| `...props` | `nav props` |  | Every native nav prop. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- A named navigation landmark; the current page is marked for screen readers and with a bar and bold text.

### Number field

A number with − and + either side. Type it, in Latin or Arabic digits, or step it with the buttons, the arrow keys, or Page Up and Down for ten steps. On leaving the field it stays inside its limits and is written in the reader's language.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/number-field

```tsx
import { NumberField } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A rough amount on a scale: [Slider](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/slider)
- A code such as an ID or a card number: [Text field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field)
- A price with a currency beside it: [Input group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/input-group)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the field. |
| `min \| max` | `number` |  | Limits. Stepping stops at them; typing is pulled back on leaving. |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | One press. Page Up and Down move ten. |
| `formatOptions` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` |  | Currency, units or decimals. With percent the value is the fraction, so step 0.01. |
| `hint \| error` | `string` |  | Help text, and the translated error that marks it invalid. |
| `decrementLabel \| incrementLabel` | `string` | `Decrease \| Increase` | Names the buttons. Translate them. |
| `value \| defaultValue \| onChange` | `number \| null` |  | Controlled or starting number. The locale is the nearest I18nProvider. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Up or Down: Step up or down by one step.
- Page Up or Page Down: Step by ten steps.
- Home or End: Go to the lowest or highest value, when there is one.
- Enter: Keep the value inside its limits and write it out.
- Latin and Arabic digits are both taken; the − and + buttons are named.

### Pagination

Moves through long lists a page at a time. A named navigation landmark: each page button says its number, the current page is marked, and the line of shown rows is announced when it changes.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/pagination

```tsx
import { Pagination } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Steps of a task: [Stepper](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stepper)
- Where the page sits in the site: [Breadcrumbs](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/breadcrumbs)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page / onPageChange` | `number / (page) => void` |  | Required. The current page, from 1. |
| `total` | `number` |  | Required. Rows across all pages. |
| `pageSize / onPageSizeChange` | `number / (size) => void` | `10` | Rows per page; a new size also calls onPageChange(1). |
| `pageSizes` | `number[]` | `[]` | Offer these sizes in a picker. Empty: no picker. |
| `labels` | `Partial<PaginationLabels>` |  | Translated texts: nav, previous, next, page(n), summary(first, last, total), pageSize. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Move between the page buttons.
- A named navigation landmark; each button says its page number, and the current page is marked.
- The line of shown rows is announced when it changes.

### Phone field

A phone number with its country code. The number reads left to right in every language, Arabic digits are welcome, and the 0 people type before a mobile number out of habit is dropped. What the form gets is one international number, ready to send a text to.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/phone-field

```tsx
import { PhoneField, PHONE_COUNTRIES } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Any other number: [Number field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/number-field)
- A one-time code sent by SMS: [PIN input](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/pin-input)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the number. |
| `country` | `string` | `EG` | The country picked at first, by ISO code. A stored number picks its own. |
| `countries` | `PhoneCountry[]` | `PHONE_COUNTRIES` | { code, dial, name }. ISO alpha-2 code supplies a flag. The Arab world first, then the most common elsewhere. |
| `countryLabel` | `string` | `Country code from labels` | Names the list for screen readers. Translate it. |
| `hint \| error \| placeholder` | `string` |  | Help text, the translated error, an example. |
| `value \| defaultValue \| onChange` | `string \| null` |  | Controlled or starting number, as E.164. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Submits the whole number with a form. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Up or Down: On the country button, open the list of countries.
- Up or Down or Home or End: In the list, move through the countries.
- Enter or Space: Pick the country.
- Escape or Tab: Close the list.
- The country button is read with the country and its code; the number reads left to right in every language.

### PIN input

A code sent by text message, one box per digit. Typing moves along, Backspace goes back, and pasting the code fills every box. On a phone the keyboard offers the code from the message, and the boxes take it all at once.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/pin-input

```tsx
import { PinInput } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A password: [Text field with type password](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field)
- A phone number: [Phone field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/phone-field)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the boxes as a group. |
| `length` | `number` | `6` | How many digits. |
| `secret` | `boolean` | `false` | Dots instead of digits, for a PIN. |
| `cellLabel` | `(n, of) => string` | ``Digit ${n} of ${of}` from labels` | Each box's name for screen readers. Translate it. |
| `hint \| error` | `string` |  | Help text, and the translated error that marks it invalid. |
| `value \| defaultValue \| onChange` | `string` |  | Controlled or starting digits. |
| `onComplete` | `(code: string) => void` |  | Every box is filled. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Submits the code as one value with a form. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- A digit: Fill the box and move to the next one.
- Backspace: In an empty box, go back to the one before.
- Left or Right: Move to the box before or after.
- Home or End: Go to the first or last box.
- Pasting the code fills every box, and phones offer the code from the message.

### Popover

A small panel next to its button, for a few details or a couple of settings. It is not modal: focus moves into it, and Escape or a click outside closes it and puts focus back on the button. Screen readers name it after the button. For a task that needs the reader's full attention, use a dialog.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/popover

```tsx
import { Popover } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A short label for an icon button: [Tooltip](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tooltip)
- A list of actions: [Menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu)
- A task that needs the reader’s full attention: [Dialog](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/dialog)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement` |  | Required. One pressable element, such as Button. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | The content of the panel. |
| `placement` | `'bottom start' \| 'top start' \| …` | `'bottom start'` | Where it opens, if there is room. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space: Open it from its button; focus moves in.
- Escape: Close it, and put focus back on the button.
- Named after its button. It is not modal, so the page stays reachable.

### Progress

How far a long task has got, such as an upload. The native progress bar, named by its label, with the amount in words beside it. Without a value it shows a moving band: work is going on but its length is not known.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/progress

```tsx
import { Progress } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A level that is not work being done, such as storage used: [Meter](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/meter)
- Waiting with no idea how long: [Spinner](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/spinner)
- Steps the reader goes through: [Stepper](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stepper)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the bar. |
| `value` | `number \| null` |  | How much is done. Leave it out when unknown. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | The value when done. |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | The amount in words; defaults to a percentage. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The native progress bar, named by its label, with the amount in words beside it.
- Without a value it shows a moving band: work is going on but its length is not known.

### Property list

Label and value pairs, such as the details of one order. Built on the native description list, so screen readers say how many items there are and pair each label with its value.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/property-list

```tsx
import { Property, PropertyList } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Many records with the same fields: [Data table](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/data-table)
- One headline number: [Stat](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stat)
- Values the reader edits: [Text field and the other form fields](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/text-field)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `'columns' \| 'stacked'` | `'columns'` | On PropertyList. Stacked puts each label above its value at any width. |
| `term` | `string` |  | On Property, required: the label. Its children are the value. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- The native description list, so each label is paired with its value.

### Radio group

One choice from a short list, with every option in view. Native radios: Tab reaches the group, arrow keys move the choice. For more than five or six options, use a select.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/radio-group

```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Several choices at once: [Checkbox](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/checkbox)
- More than about 7 options: [Select](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/select)
- Switch the view of the page: [Segmented control](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/segmented-control)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the group. |
| `options` | `RadioOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? } for each radio. |
| `value, defaultValue` | `T` |  | The chosen value, controlled or not. |
| `onChange` | `(value: T) => void` |  | Called with the new choice. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | Side by side for two or three short answers. |
| `hint, error` | `string` |  | As for the text field. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables every radio. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Form field name; made up when left out. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid prefix; each radio gets -<index>. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Reach the group, on the chosen option.
- Arrow keys: Move the choice to the next or previous option.
- Native radios in a named group, so the group name is read first.

### Rating

Stars out of five, to pick a score or to show one. Picking uses real radio buttons, so Tab reaches the stars, arrow keys move between them and a screen reader says 3 stars, 3 of 5. Filled stars are solid and empty ones an outline, so the shape tells them apart, not only colour.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/rating

```tsx
import { Rating } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- An exact number: [Number field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/number-field)
- Show a score the reader cannot change: [Meter](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/meter)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the stars, as the fieldset legend. Required when people pick. |
| `max` | `number` | `5` | How many stars. |
| `starLabel` | `(stars: number) => string` | ``${n} stars` from labels` | The name of one star, read by screen readers. Translate it. |
| `scoreLabel` | `(value, max) => string` | ``${v} out of ${m} stars` from labels` | The read-only score in words. Translate it. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Only shows value; nothing to pick. |
| `value \| defaultValue` | `number \| null` |  | Controlled or starting score. |
| `onChange` | `(value: number) => void` |  | Called with the picked number of stars. |
| `name \| disabled` | `string \| boolean` |  | Passed to the radios and the fieldset. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Reach the group, on the chosen option.
- Arrow keys: Move the choice to the next or previous option.
- Real radio buttons, read as 3 stars, 3 of 5.
- Filled stars are solid and empty ones an outline, so shape tells them apart.

### Search field

A box to search with: a magnifier, the text, and a × to clear it. Escape clears it too, and Enter searches. A real search input, so phones show a Search key and screen readers say search.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/search-field

```tsx
import { SearchField } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Search the whole app and run commands: [Command palette](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/command-palette)
- Pick one value from a list as you type: [Combobox](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/combobox)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the field. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the label for screen readers only. |
| `placeholder \| hint` | `string` |  | An example inside the box; help text under it. |
| `clearLabel` | `string` | `Clear search from labels` | Names the × button. Translate it. |
| `value \| defaultValue \| onChange` | `string` |  | Controlled or starting text. |
| `onSearch` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Enter was pressed. |
| `disabled \| name` | `boolean \| string` |  | Passed to the input. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter: Search.
- Escape: Clear the text.
- A real search input, read as search; the clear button is named.

### Segmented control

One choice from two to five short options, side by side: a view, a period, a size. Radio buttons underneath, so Tab reaches the group and the arrow keys move the choice. The chosen one is lifted onto a tile with an edge, not just coloured.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/segmented-control

```tsx
import { SegmentedControl } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Show different panels of content: [Tabs](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/tabs)
- A choice sent with a form: [Radio group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/radio-group)
- One option that is on or off: [Toggle](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/toggle)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the group for screen readers. |
| `options` | `{ value, label, icon?, disabled? }[]` |  | Two to five short options. |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows only the icons; the words are still read. |
| `block` | `boolean` | `false` | Fills the width, segments sharing it. |
| `value \| defaultValue \| onChange` | `string` |  | Controlled or starting choice. |
| `disabled \| name` | `boolean \| string` |  | Passed to the radios. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Tab: Reach the group, on the chosen option.
- Arrow keys: Move the choice to the next or previous option.
- Radio buttons underneath; the chosen option is lifted onto a tile with an edge, not only coloured.

### Select

One choice from a list. Arrow keys, Home and End, and typing the first letters all move through the options; Escape and Tab close the list and return focus.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/select

```tsx
import { Select, type SelectOption } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- A long list the reader searches: [Combobox](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/combobox)
- Two to five options that fit on screen: [Radio group](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/radio-group)
- Actions, not values: [Menu](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/menu)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. The visible label; it names the button and the list. |
| `options` | `SelectOption<T>[]` |  | Required. { value, label, disabled? } for each option; value is a string or number. |
| `value / defaultValue` | `T \| null` |  | The chosen value, controlled or not. |
| `onChange` | `(value: T) => void` |  | Called with the value of the picked option. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Shown while nothing is chosen. |
| `error` | `string` |  | The translated error. Marks the field invalid and announces the message. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the select. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Field name, so the value is sent with a native form. |
| `testId` | `string` |  | data-testid on the button; options get -option-<index>. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Enter or Space or Up or Down: Open the list.
- Up or Down or Home or End: Move through the options.
- Letters: Jump to the option that starts with them.
- Enter or Space: Pick the option.
- Escape or Tab: Close the list, and put focus back on the button.
- Read as a list box, with the chosen option and the field’s label.

### Skeleton

Grey shapes where content is loading, so the page does not jump when it arrives. Screen readers skip the shapes: mark the area busy and say it is loading with a spinner or a status message. With reduced motion the shapes stop pulsing.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/skeleton

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Work with a known length: [Progress](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/progress)
- A short wait inside a button: [Spinner](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/spinner)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `'text' \| 'circle' \| 'block'` | `'text'` | Lines, an avatar, or an image or card. |
| `lines` | `number` | `1` | Lines of text; the last one is shorter. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Screen readers skip the shapes: mark the area busy and say it is loading in words.
- With reduced motion the shapes stop pulsing.

### Slider

A value picked along a range, such as a price limit or a volume. It is the browser's own range input, so arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End all move it, and the value is written beside the label. For an exact number, use a number field.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/slider

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
// Every other prop goes to the input: step, name, disabled, ref.
```

When to use something else:

- An exact value: [Number field](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/number-field)
- Show a level the reader cannot change: [Meter](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/meter)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required. Names the slider. |
| `min \| max` | `number` | `0 \| 100` | The ends of the range. |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | How far one arrow key press moves it. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | The value as shown and as read aloud, with its unit. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Help under the slider, read after the label. |
| `value \| defaultValue` | `number` |  | Controlled or starting value. |
| `...props` | `input props` |  | Every native input prop: onChange, name, disabled, ref. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Left or Right or Up or Down: Move by one step.
- Page Up or Page Down: Move by a bigger step.
- Home or End: Go to the lowest or highest value.
- The browser’s own range input, named by its label; the value is also written beside it.

### Spinner

Shows that something is loading and says what, in words, to screen readers. Keep it for waits of more than a second. With reduced motion it stops turning and stays as a faint ring.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/spinner

```tsx
import { Spinner } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:

- Work with a known length: [Progress](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/progress)
- A whole page or card that is loading: [Skeleton](https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/skeleton)

| Name | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `'Loading' from labels` | What is loading, translated. |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the label next to it too. |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | lg: a big spinner over its label. |

Keyboard and screen readers:

- Says what is loading, in words, to screen readers.
- With reduced motion it stops turning and stays as a faint ring.

### Stat

One number with its label, and how it changed. The change is written out, with its sign or in words; the arrow and the colour only repeat it.

Docs: https://ghazal-ui.github.io/ghazal/components/stat

```tsx
import { Stat } from '@ghazal-ui/react';
```

When to use something else:
